description: This file contains JUnit unit tests for the ImmutableJsonBoolean class in the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It verifies immutability, equality, type-specific properties, and behavior of usings as boolean JSON value.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonBooleanTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the ImmutableJsonBoolean class, testing properties, behaviors, and type-specific methods of JSON boolean objects.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a default ImmutableJsonBoolean instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableJsonBoolean instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks that equals and hashCode methods are properly implemented for ImmutableJsonBoolean.

methods.name: asBooleanReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests the asBoolean() method returns the correct boolean value.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that the toString() method returns 'false' for the FALSE instance.

methods.name: isNotNull
methods.description: Confirms that the isNull() method returns false.

methods.name: isNotNumber
methods.description: Ensures isNumber() and related numerical type queries return false.

methods.name: tryToGetAsInt
methods.description: Verifies that calling asInt() on a boolean throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: tryToGetAsLong
methods.description: Verifies that calling asLong() on a boolean throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: tryToGetAsDouble
methods.description: Verifies that calling asDouble() on a boolean throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: tryToGetAsString
methods.description: Verifies that calling asString() on a boolean throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: tryToGetAsObject
methods.description: Verifies that calling asObject() on a boolean throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: tryToGetAsArray
methods.description: Verifies that calling asArray() on a boolean throws UnsupportedOperationException.
